__comment: Not cube_all. Minecraft shades every block face by direction (top 1.0, sides 0.8/0.6, bottom 0.5), darkens corners with ambient occlusion, and multiplies by the lightmap. Nullstone survives all three because black times anything is black - white does not, which is why plain white read as quartz. shade:false kills the directional shading, ambientocclusion:false kills the corner darkening, and neoforge_data's block_light/sky_light 15 pins the lightmap to full so external light cannot touch it. This is render-only: the block still emits no light of its own.
